entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker from Ixalan's Sun Empire, a warrior-poet studying Ravnica's guild governments, who trades letters with a mysterious stranger signed R.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artisan planeswalker from Kaladesh who writes to Huatli as R, seeking copper for a project for a friend; Huatli met her on her first planeswalk.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A figure whose curse word Huatli borrows.

entities.name: Traveler's Noticeboard
entities.description: A warded bulletin board outside an inn in Precinct Five of Ravnica that only planeswalkers can see, used for trades and messages.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Huatli studies the guilds and the noticeboard hangs.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Huatli's home plane, source of the copper she brought to trade.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Huatli first met Saheeli during her first planeswalk.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where R says she has been staying.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane that R recommends visiting for its dance hall in Park Heights.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane named in one of the notices.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane named in one of the notices.

entities.name: Iveta's Tavern
entities.description: The tavern in the Tenth District of Ravnica where Huatli and R plan to meet.

entities.name: Precinct Five
entities.description: The district of Ravnica where the inn with the noticeboard stands.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose legislative records Huatli consults.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose sub-lieutenant Huatli meets.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Huatli's home nation, whose copper she offers.

events.summary: Huatli sees a note on the Traveler's Noticeboard seeking raw copper and starts a correspondence with its author, R.
events.quote: Not one to leave a stranger in want, Huatli rises on her tiptoes to snag an old piece of paper

events.summary: Huatli leaves a lump of Sun Empire copper in a warded box with a note asking if R is a spy.
events.quote: Huatli places a medium-sized lump of Sun Empire copper inside

events.summary: R replies that she is no spy but a lady, and that the copper is for a project for a friend; she asks what brings Huatli to the plane.
events.quote: I'm a lady, not a liar.

events.summary: Huatli writes that she is studying the guilds' executive structure to bring lessons home and asks whether it is naive to seek utopia.
events.quote: I've spent the last two months on this plane studying the executive structure of the guilds.

events.summary: R answers that her mentor's inability to be impressed has made her a creator who never stops, and says she thinks Huatli's wish is beautiful.
events.quote: My mentor's inability to be impressed has led me to be the kind of creator who can't ever put down my tools and call it a day.

events.summary: R invites Huatli to meet on Dominaria; Huatli agrees, and R later proposes a drink.
events.quote: Want to meet up for a drink?

events.summary: Huatli proposes meeting at Iveta's Tavern at moonrise, and R accepts and suggests dancing afterward in New Capenna.
events.quote: We can meet at Iveta's for round one and planeswalk from there?

events.summary: On her way to the tavern, Huatli runs into Saheeli, whom she met on Kaladesh on her first planeswalk, and rushes off without confessing her feelings.
events.quote: "I have to go," Huatli adds, interrupting whatever Saheeli was about to say.

events.summary: At Iveta's Tavern, Huatli and Saheeli discover that H is Huatli and R is Rai, each the stranger the other has been writing to.
The two women share coffee, leave together, and kiss under Ravnica's sky before planeswalking to another plane.
events.quote: their lips gently and tentatively meet under the indigo reach of Ravnica's sky

relations.note: They discover they are pen pals attracted to each other and leave on a date.
relations.quote: their lips gently and tentatively meet under the indigo reach of Ravnica's sky

relations.note: Huatli's copper is from her home nation.
relations.quote: a medium-sized lump of Sun Empire copper

relations.note: Hangs outside an inn in Precinct Five.
relations.quote: On the exterior wall of an inn in Precinct Five on the city-plane of Ravnica hangs the Traveler's Noticeboard
